def transform(grid):
    # Arrange the nonzero objects as a descending diagonal chain, preserving
    # their shapes and colors; later objects overwrite overlaps.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]

            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==color:

            top=min(y for y,x in cells); left=min(x for y,x in cells)
